<subject>Re: Lumière Santé, Lyon Patient Data</subject>

Bernard,  
?  
We've completed a review this morning to try to fill in missing pieces of information on hourly patient admissions, ICU bed availability, and treatment logs for Lyon and have not come up with anything yet. Would you know of any of the above information which would assist us in our efforts? ? Thanks, ? Eugène Leconte ?
